cause.what_happened: EDRY fell about 19% intraday on 2026-09-22 (gap +0.19%, intraday -19.2%, 2.56x volume, screen 15:05 ET) with no EDGAR filing since 2026-09-11 and no press release since 2026-08-06. It came after a +196% 60-day and +45% 20-day run on a 2.87m-share base, with a $20m ATM open since 09-11 and director sales through August, so this reads as a momentum unwind into open supply rather than news.

findings.finding: An effective $20m at-the-market program (A.G.P., equity distribution agreement dated 2026-09-11, F-3 effective 2026-09-03) can sell EDRY stock on 2026-09-23 into any rebound. It is about 12-13% of market cap at $55, roughly 364k shares against ~$9.5m median daily turnover.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The agreement allows sales on any trading day, settling T+1, and needs no new filing. Draws are disclosed only with quarterly results, so tomorrow's supply is live inside the window and invisible to the tape. EuroDry has drawn ATMs before: the 2021-06 and 2021-10 424B5s and the 2023-10 424B5 with its 6-K.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None in the baseline: history.n = 0 comparable falls. The earlier ATMs (2021, 2023) are documented, but their next-day price effect is not measured here.
findings.why_not_priced: Today's intraday tape priced a momentum unwind. It has not priced the agent selling into a relief bounce tomorrow, when the issuer has the most reason to draw after a +196% 60-day run. If the market held this, a 19% fall with no news on only 2.56x volume would attract no bounce buyers; instead the cross-section for this drop band is mildly positive (+0.27).
findings.independence: The company's repeated past ATM use, from EDGAR full-text search (2021-06-11, 2021-10-12, 2023-10-11 424B5s): https://efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index?q=%22at-the-market%22&ciks=0001731388&startdt=2019-01-01&enddt=2026-09-22. The $200m F-3 shelf of 2026-08-27 also permits an overnight registered direct: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1731388/000091957426005806/p15057625_f-3.htm
